dedupe_keys.name: nerc geomagnetic disturbance gmd data gic and magnetometer measurements from north american utilities for strong storms kp 7

description: NERC's Geomagnetic Disturbance Data program collects measurements of geomagnetically induced currents (GIC) and magnetic field variations from North American power utilities during strong geomagnetic storms, and makes them available for research on the risk such storms pose to the bulk power system. It is run by NERC, the North American Electric Reliability Corporation, as specified in FERC Order No. 830. Coverage: reporting entities across the North American grid; data are collected for designated strong GMD events with a planetary Kp index of 7 or more, and the event list names 41 events from 2013E01 (31 May 2013) to 2026E03 (4 July 2026), with Kp values from 7 to 9 and start and end dates in UTC. Format and access: an event list page, a GMD reporting application for utilities, a user guide (2021), an event data download guide (2022) and an event review of the May 2024 storm (published March 2026); the download route and any account requirement are described in the download guide PDF, which was not read, and the site renders from embedded page data. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: only strong events are collected, coverage depends on which utilities report and where their monitors sit, and the data format was not checked. Simulation uses: validating geoelectric field and GIC models and assessing transformer and grid hazard exposure, cascading failure and resilience under space weather. Related records: the NOAA major storm geoelectric simulations (data-swpt-major-storm-geoelectric-simulations) model the geoelectric fields that drive these currents.
